message.abstract: <jats:p>The book "Artificial Intelligence: Fundamentals of Prompt Engineering with ChatGPT as a Creativity-Driving Innovation" is a comprehensive guide to understanding the fundamentals of artificial intelligence (AI) and its practical applications, with a focus on the transformative impact of ChatGPT. It covers the theoretical foundations of AI, including its definition, historical evolution, key architectures, and practical strategies for prompt engineering.<br><br>With over 500 prompts, the book offers detailed techniques for maximizing ChatGPT’s capabilities across text, images, and video. It explores generative AI (GenAI), focusing on models like GPT and addressing strategies to handle controversies.<br><br>Additionally, the book provides practical recommendations for using ChatGPT effectively, offering prompts and tools for various fields such as education, marketing, and project management. It also introduces a range of available GenAI software and its expanding applications.</jats:p>
title: Artificial Intelligence: Fundamentals of Prompt Engineering with ChatGPT as a Creativity-Driving Innovation
